title: One-prompt 5-minute 3D animation built in procedural Three.js + Remotion (with Whisper audio sync & headless Chrome visual self-review)
author: Western-Airline9355
selftext:
>**What it is:** A 5:06 animated explainer (1080p at 30 fps) for a concept I'm working on: a solar-powered microfactory in a 40-foot shipping container that turns waste HDPE plastic and sand into roof tiles (100 tiles per shift). The video walks through all seven stations (shred, dry and screen sand, weigh, mix, press, cool, trim), then the solar canopy and battery. It features animated workers who sort plastic, tip bins, and push molds into the press, plus labels, music, and sound effects synced to the voiceover.  
**How I used Claude Code:** I gave it one prompt, my voiceover audio file, and five screenshots of my 3D model as a style reference.*(Note: This is a concept layout, not a validated machine design, and the video states that too. Interactive browser version linked in the comments below!)*
